newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures ease on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures ease on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly weaker on Wednesday as caution that prices were too high prompted private investors to take profits, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen per kg lower to 0.4 yen higher. Benchmark April was 0.4 yen lower at 142.9 yen.
The market started the day on an easier tone in reaction to recent price rises and the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar, the traders said.
"Prices are unlikely to dip sharply on technical factors, but the upside of 145 yen for the benchmark April would be tough to break through," one trader said.
